original: How ridiculous and what a stranger he is who is surprised at anything which happens in life.

notification_original: How ridiculous and what a stranger he is who is surprised at anything which happens in life.

explained.summary: Being surprised by anything that happens in life is ridiculous, Marcus says, and it marks you out as a stranger in the world. Illness, loss, rudeness and setbacks are all part of the ordinary run of things. Someone who understands how the world works expects them and isn’t knocked flat when they arrive.
